purpose: Per-JSON-Schema-keyword record of how many times the AUTHORITATIVE schema uses it and whether tests/test_diagnostics.py covers it. Buckets partition every keyword the configured validator could act on, so coverage can neither be invented nor silently omitted.
authority: The schema is the only authority. This file is a coverage ledger; it declares no rules and is never consulted at runtime.
gate: tests/test_diagnostics.py::test_coverage_artifact_matches_the_authoritative_schema re-measures the schema on every run and fails on any drift, so this file cannot go stale silently. If the schema is refreshed from upstream, regenerate this file alongside schema/PROVENANCE.md.
counting_method: Recursive walk that descends only into positions where a subschema is expected, so a key is counted as a keyword only in keyword position. Field names are not keywords: the schema declares fields literally named `type`, `value` and `method`, so a naive key count inflates `type` from 297 to 300.

format.reason: JSON Schema 2020-12 makes `format` an annotation. official.load_official_validator builds Draft202012Validator(schema) with no format_checker, so none of the 6 `format: date-time` declarations can produce an error. This layer must not add enforcement the truth path does not have.

properties.reason: descends into named subschemas; errors are reported under the failing inner keyword

items.reason: descends into array-item subschemas; errors are reported under the failing inner keyword

allOf.reason: unconditional composition; errors are reported under the failing inner keyword and are NOT marked conditional

if.reason: guard only; a failing `if` is suppressed, and `then`/`else` errors are reported under the failing inner keyword

else.reason: the authoritative schema declares no `else` branch

notes: Three families the authorizing brief called out as empty are confirmed empty: anyOf=0, dependentRequired=0, minProperties=0. No coverage is claimed for them.
`else`=0 as well; the schema's 7 conditionals are all if/then with no else branch.
The schema measures 57293 bytes, not the 31372 stated in the authorizing brief. Every keyword count in that brief is confirmed correct.
The brief also stated the schema has no `title` anywhere; it has exactly one, the root schema's own title. No PROPERTY has a title, so label derivation still has nothing to reuse.
`format` is the one keyword present in the schema yet structurally unable to produce a diagnostic; see present_but_not_enforceable.
